newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Japan gives Zambia 800 mln yen for fertiliser.
newsitem.headline: Japan gives Zambia 800 mln yen for fertiliser.

text.p: Japan has given Zambia an 800 million yen grant to increase food production, Japan's Ambassador to Zambia, Tadashi Masui, said on Wednesday.
Masui said in a statement the grant would be used to procure urea fertiliser to enhance self-support schemes and would be distributed for sale among small-scale farmers.
Japan has provided a total of 13.3 billion yen in grants for food production in Zambia since 1981.
Western governments, including Japan, cut balance of payment support to Zambia last year in protest against the way general elections were organised on November 18.
Most Western governments say they will maintain the cuts in balance of payment support this year. But other forms of aid, including project aid, have not been affected.
